title: VPA: ignore stale lastState OOMs in the quick-OOM path

proposed.title: VPA Quick OOM must check if OOM is recent

saved.title: VPA Quick OOM must check if OOM is recent
saved.body:
Symptom: VPA updater continuously forces updates, treating a days-old short OOM as a fresh quick OOM under `updateMode: InPlace`.
Root cause: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/priority/update_priority_calculator.go:UpdatePriorityCalculator.AddPod`
Fix pattern: When checking `lastState.terminated` for quick OOMs, verify both that the runtime was short (`FinishedAt - StartedAt < threshold`) AND that the OOM happened recently (`now - FinishedAt < threshold`).
Constraints: Essential for InPlace update mode where `lastState` is preserved indefinitely. For Recreate mode, this is a no-op since eviction drops `lastState`.

title: VPA recommender: fix checkpoint garbage collection timeout

proposed.title: Independent context timeouts for VPA checkpoint maintenance
Aggregating errors during item-level garbage collection

saved.title: Independent context timeouts for VPA checkpoint maintenance
saved.body:
Symptom: VPA checkpoint resources gradually grow and are never garbage collected on large clusters.
Root cause: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/routines/recommender.go:MaintainCheckpoints`
Fix pattern: Use independent context timeouts for sequential operations (writing checkpoints vs. garbage collecting them) so that a timeout in the first does not instantly abort the second.
Constraints: When recording the completion of periodic tasks, only update the last-run timestamp (`lastCheckpointGC`) if the operation completes successfully without errors, ensuring retries on the next interval.

saved.title: Aggregating errors during item-level garbage collection
saved.body:
Symptom: The garbage collection caller thinks the process succeeded even if some or all item deletions failed, preventing proper retries.
Root cause: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/input/cluster_feeder.go:GarbageCollectCheckpoints`
Fix pattern: Instead of just logging errors and returning silently, accumulate errors for individual item failures using `errors.Join()` and return the combined error to the caller.
Constraints: When iterating over multiple resources to clean up, a failure on one item must not halt the loop; processing must continue for the rest while capturing the error.

title: VPA updater: fix unready DaemonSet updates

proposed.title: Use DesiredNumberScheduled for DaemonSet target size instead of NumberReady

saved.title: Use DesiredNumberScheduled for DaemonSet target size instead of NumberReady
saved.body:
Symptom: VPA fails to scale up DaemonSet pods if they all crash and become unready, throwing a "has no number ready pods" error.
Root cause: Logic determining desired replicas incorrectly read from `DaemonSet.Status.NumberReady` (vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/restriction/pods_restriction_factory.go:getReplicaCount).
Fix pattern: Use `DaemonSet.Status.DesiredNumberScheduled` to determine how many pods should exist, regardless of their current ready state.
Constraints: `NumberReady` is only appropriate when you strictly need to know the count of healthy pods; use `DesiredNumberScheduled` when evaluating scale targets or eviction limits.

title: Fix instance name extraction for placeholder nodes when ASG name contains '/'

proposed.title: AWS Cloud Provider: Parse placeholder node names containing slashes

saved.title: AWS Cloud Provider: Parse placeholder node names containing slashes
saved.body:
Symptom: cluster-autoscaler fails to delete placeholder nodes and halts scaling operations when ASG names contain slashes.
Root cause: `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/aws/aws_cloud_provider.go`:`AwsRefFromProviderId` truncated instance names by splitting the provider ID on `/`.
Fix pattern: Use regex capture groups instead of `strings.Split` to extract the full placeholder name, preserving embedded slashes.
Constraints: The regex `validAwsRefIdRegex` must correctly distinguish placeholder instances (which capture the rest of the string including slashes) from regular instances.

title: Add topology.kubernetes.io/zone to CAPI extracted template labels

proposed.title: Preserve topology.kubernetes.io/zone for CAPI scale-up simulation

saved.title: Preserve topology.kubernetes.io/zone for CAPI scale-up simulation
saved.body:
Symptom: Cluster-api scale-up does not trigger for pods requiring `topology.kubernetes.io/zone`.
Root cause: `extractNodeLabels` (cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_nodegroup.go) omitted the stable `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` label when generating the template node for scale-up simulation.
Fix pattern: Copy `corev1.LabelTopologyZone` from existing nodes into the template node.
Constraints: Autoscaled template nodes must retain topology labels to satisfy pod scheduling requirements during simulation.

title: VPA InPlace: treat ResizeError as deferred, not infeasible

proposed.title: VPA InPlace: Transient Resize Errors vs Infeasible

saved.title: VPA InPlace: Transient Resize Errors vs Infeasible
saved.body:
Symptom: VPA in-place resize gets stuck and is not retried after a temporary kubelet error.
Root cause: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/restriction/pods_inplace_restriction.go:CanInPlaceUpdate` returning `utils.InPlaceInfeasible` caches the recommendation as permanently infeasible, only retrying if the recommendation changes.
Fix pattern: Map transient errors (like `utils.ResizeStatusError`) to `utils.InPlaceDeferred` so the next loop can retry without caching permanent infeasibility.
Constraints: Reserve `utils.InPlaceInfeasible` for true capacity infeasibility (e.g., node cannot accommodate the resize).

title: scaleway: report node in error as InstanceCreating so CA detects it faster

proposed.title: Map node creation errors to InstanceCreating for faster CA detection

saved.title: Map node creation errors to InstanceCreating for faster CA detection
saved.body:
Symptom: Cluster Autoscaler is slow to detect when a node fails to create.
Root cause: The cloud provider status mapping (`fromScwStatus`) did not explicitly set a state for node creation errors.
Fix pattern: Map the provider's creation error status explicitly to `cloudprovider.InstanceCreating` while also attaching the error details in `ErrorInfo`.
Constraints: CA expects to find creation errors on instances that are actively in the `InstanceCreating` state. If the state is not mapped, CA may ignore the error information and wait for a long timeout instead of failing fast.

title: cloudprovider/clusterapi: Implement machine phase check during the scale up

proposed.title: Check machine phase before marking as failed in clusterapi provider

saved.title: Check machine phase before marking as failed in clusterapi provider
saved.body:
Symptom: The cluster-autoscaler marks clusterapi machines as failed even when they are still in the Provisioning state.
Root cause: `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_controller.go:findScalableResourceProviderIDs` treated machines as failed solely based on the presence of a Status.FailureMessage.
Fix pattern: Explicitly verify that the machine's `status.phase` is "Failed" before treating it as permanently failed and creating a normalized provider ID.
Constraints: The "Failed" phase is deprecated in Cluster API. The check for `machinePhase == "Failed"` should be removed in a future release (e.g., v1.15).

title: fix(vpa): do not discard fresh OOMs near aggregation boundary

proposed.title: Use latest sample time instead of WindowEnd for staleness checks

saved.title: Use latest sample time instead of WindowEnd for staleness checks
saved.body:
Symptom: A recent OOM event is incorrectly discarded as "too old", preventing the expected memory request bump-up.
Root cause: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/model/container.go:ContainerState.RecordOOM` checked the OOM timestamp against `WindowEnd`, an aggregation boundary that can sit up to a full interval ahead of the actual latest sample.
Fix pattern: Change the reference point for the staleness check from the inflated window boundary to the most recently observed memory sample time.
Constraints: When checking if an event is stale relative to the container's state, compare against `lastMemorySampleStart` (handling its zero-value case), not `WindowEnd`. `WindowEnd` jumps by full intervals and does not accurately represent the latest observed time for staleness thresholds.

title: vpa/admission-controller: escape extended resource names in JSONPatch paths

proposed.title: Escape special characters in JSONPatch paths

saved.title: Escape special characters in JSONPatch paths
saved.body:
Symptom: VPA resource policies (like maxAllowed caps) are silently bypassed for pods requesting extended resources like GPUs.
Root cause: Unescaped interpolation in `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/admission-controller/resource/pod/patch/util.go:GetAddResourceRequirementValuePatch` generates invalid JSONPatch paths for resources containing `/` or `~`.
Fix pattern: Escape special characters in dynamic segments before interpolating them into JSONPatch paths (replace `~` with `~0`, then `/` with `~1`).
Constraints: Any new admission patches must use `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/admission-controller/resource/pod/patch/util.go:escapeJSONPatchPath` to format keys, and replacement order must be strictly preserved to prevent double-escaping.
